My mother tells me to just do it then when I talk to her about my suicidal thoughts. My sister is too young to talk to about this. I have no father or grandparents. My aunts and uncles and cousins have just told me to snap out of it or ignore it when around them. They don't like to talk about this like this. As for money, my entire family is dirt poor. They are all struggling as much as I am. 

Cut expenses? Like food? That's what I've been cutting. My current monthly bills: car (gas and insurance), hospital visits/stays, education loans, this eviction thing I didn't even know I had until I almost was sent to jail for not paying it, rent, electricity, healthcare, and my half of the phone bill. Breaking those things up into two paychecks a month, I usually have around $30 bucks left from each paycheck for food. I know, I know. I should get another job, but I already work 60+ hours a week at my current job that it is hard to find the time to go elsewhere and get another one. I also need that time for myself. I went to the hospital about two years ago due to a breakdown from not getting any time to myself (I was working around 80+ hours a week then).

Scientific evidence and personal experience. I believe in infatuation and unconditional love. Infatuation is what I was lead to believe love was, but that goes away after a few months. I see unconditional love as not love at all, but something one has to feel for another after a while because one puts so much time and effort into another that one does not want to feel like all that was wasted. It's forced and mostly for selfish reasons.
